other_conditions: Must have at least 0.5 hectares of irrigated agricultural land
Construction must start only after administrative approval of the Agriculture Department
Verification will be done by the department before and after construction
Installation of drip/sprinkler set on the dig is mandatory
benefits_summary: Provides a subsidy of 75‑85% and a grant of up to ₹3,40,000 for constructing a dig for irrigation.
